fusions.name: Fox in the Henhouse
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 5 tiles onto the target and pecks it for 12 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Latch Clatter
fusions.desc: Batters every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage, with a 15% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Coop Slats
fusions.desc: Throws up a slatted fence 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Safe Behind Bars
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
